text: Apple deserves a mention, from personal experience. My school only allowed Apple computers for middle and high schoolers. They cost about twice as much as alternatives and would break like once a month. I never dropped my laptop. But I changed the hard drive 5 times in 4 years and reinstalled the OS many times. A friend's MacBook Pro even caught fire while he was watching a movie, smoke alarm went off. And Apple support never diagnosed anything. They would just back up the computer, wipe it and restore files. Same with iPhones. I had the first iPhone and it would malfunction constantly. Now Apple puts out a new iPhone every 2 months or so, only the camera is slightly better. I'll only give them credit for iPads, which are the best tablets right now, but Android tablets might catch up.
